label: Catalog item reference
description: The catalog item a request was raised from (for example "New laptop"). Stores the item's stable ID; the item's variables and fulfillment tasks come from it. Used only on entities with a request binding.
usage: One per request entity, named catalog_item and referenced by the entity's request binding.
Show it as a label in the request header so agents see what was asked for.
constraints: The value must be the ID of an active catalog item whose requestEntity is this entity.
It cannot change after the request is created.
Not searchable; filter on it with ==.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.notes: Rendered as the item's label, not its ID.
